# Comparison of 3* armor effects when using a full set

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_67_nukaknights-post-ruestung-effekt-volles-set.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

#### **Foods, Drinks, Chems Weight Loss**

- 
 Covers 6 perk points (First Aid Kit 3, Thru-Hiker 3).

**Ammunition weight reduction**

- 
 Covers 5 perk points (weapon belt 2, batteries included 3)
- 
 Does not reduce the weight of grenades, rockets, mini nukes and 40mm grenades (explosive carriers)

**Weapon weight reduction**

- 
 Covers approximately 12 perk points (Martial Artist 3, Strong as a Bear 3, Shotgun Fan 3, Light Luggage 3), with reservations as these perks have other benefits
- 
 Reduces the weight of rifles for which there is no other perk card
- 
 Reduces the weight of grenades and mines
- 
 Unlike the legendary "90% weight reduction" effect, weapon weight reduction also reduces the weight of weapon mods
- 
 Stacks up with 90% weight reduction. A 90% weight-reduced car grenade launcher would have no weight reduction. Armor weighs about 2.0. With weight red. Armor weight drops to about 0.2

**Scrap weight reduction**

- 
 Covers approximately 3.5 Perks points, as 5 pieces reducing the weight of scrap by 90%, with the card "Messi" at level 3 reducing scrap by 75%

**Hard to detect while sneaking**

- 
 Covers 3 perk points, as 5 pieces have the same effect as the level 3 card "Sneak".
- 
 Doesn't stack, 1 part with the perk is enough. 5 is 4 too many.
- 
 Angry Turtle on Sneak Coverage: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-qtKEDDHb-4

**Guardian / Cavalier**

- 
 Unique effects that have no alternative perk card
- 
 Each piece gives you a 75% chance to reduce damage by 15%, depending on whether you are standing still (Guardian) or sprinting (Cavalier).
- 
 Guardian doesn't work while sneaking https://i.imgur.com/yQPwDUF.png

**50% durability**

- 
 A full set should be worth 2 perk points (White Knight at level 3 provides 60% more durability with less repair costs)

**15% less body part damage**

- 
 A full set reduces body part damage by 75%
- 
 Covers just over 2 perk points, as level 2 Adamantium Skeleton reduces 66% and level 3 reduces 100%

**15% less damage when blocking**

- 
 Good for those who block.

**The Acrobat**

- 
 Each piece reduces fall damage by 50%
- 
 Two pieces of it are enough to jump down anywhere without taking damage (like in power armor)

**Breathe underwater**

- 
 Covers less than 1 perk point, as Aquaboy/girl also avoids radiation damage when swimming, which this effect cannot do

**The Safecracker**

- 
 Each piece provides 20% more "correct" area when picking locks

Source with original post: https://www.reddit.com/.../comparison_of_3rd_star_armor.../
